description: Describe what the user wants in plain words and get back whether this server can do it, which limits it would hit, and the closest thing it CAN do. Instant, no solve. Use it when unsure the tool fits (shift swaps, payroll, time clocks, very large teams or long horizons).

description.description: The user's request in their own words, e.g. 'rota for 80 nurses over 3 months with shift swaps'.

name: check_request
title: Check whether a request fits
